output.title: I built Streakly, a habit tracker that lets you repair missed days instead of losing your streak
output.body:
I kept quitting habit apps because one missed day broke the streak — and that broke my motivation. So I built Streakly: if you miss a day, you can repair it by doubling up within the week. Your streak survives.

It scores habits against weekly targets, not daily chains, based on behavior-change research. No social feed, no leaderboards, no shame. Everything stays private on your device.

We tested with 800 people — 41% were still tracking at day 30, and we got a 4.8-star average from 96 reviews. The most-requested feature (streak repair) is free and built in, not locked behind paywalls.

I'm the builder, and I'd love your feedback: what would make this fit better into your routine? Any red flags I’m missing? Check it out at {APP_URL}.
warnings: This post discloses the builder relationship and avoids hype, aligning with r/productivity's rules against promotional content. However, as a beta app promotion, some users may still perceive it as marketing.
